name: Jariel Balberona
headline: Staff-Level AI-Native Software Engineer | Product & Platform Engineering
summary: Staff-level software engineer with 10+ years of experience building and modernizing production products across frontend, backend, mobile, cloud, and delivery infrastructure. Strong in TypeScript, React and Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, multi-tenant SaaS, offline-first systems, AWS, Azure, automated QA, observability, and production operations. Designs AI-native engineering workflows that turn scoped product intent into repository-grounded implementation, deterministic verification, bounded correction, and controlled release decisions.

highlights: Serve as technical lead and CTO-level owner on product engagements: set technical direction, architecture, delivery priorities and release decisions for multi-tenant SaaS products.
Architect and operate agentic software-delivery systems, defining repository context, reusable skills, task orchestration, tool permissions, verification gates and release controls.
Run lead agents and isolated per-task environments on a remote Linux server, with scoped permissions and human approval for credentials, production changes and releases.
Design multi-tenant product architecture across Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and cloud delivery, including tenant permissions, authentication, administration and change-request workflows.
Define acceptance criteria and evidence requirements that distinguish implemented, verified, deployed and observed-working outcomes.
Architect and build a hospitality platform connecting point of sale, customer ordering, kitchen operations, inventory and staff workflows across web and mobile.
Design offline synchronization, durable queues, restart recovery and idempotent operations to handle intermittent connectivity and shared-device workflows.
Own the TypeScript, React, Node.js and PostgreSQL stack, React Native / Expo clients, Render and Cloudflare delivery, automated tests and production release decisions.

Design the repository-owned agentic delivery workflow used to build it: scoped agent implementation, automated checks, physical-device verification, bounded correction and explicit human release authority.
Led incremental frontend modernization from CRA to Vite, SASS to Tailwind CSS v4 and React 17 to 19 while preserving established production behavior.
Restructured the application into feature modules and moved Redux-heavy server-data flows to TanStack Query and Zustand, with explicit cache invalidation and optimistic updates.
Introduced Vitest, Biome and delivery checks, and delivered features across the frontend and NestJS / PostgreSQL backend.
Built analytical interfaces for an AI product, including heatmaps, treemaps and stacked bars, with explicit progress, result and failure states for asynchronous queries.
Built the Agents V1 node-based workflow interface for data-source, prompt, condition and recipient flows using React and TypeScript.
